text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Sounds of Earth—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I was wondering where that lovely aria 
was coming from—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
So it all started from right here, my 
little musicistas...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking where Sounds of Earth pointed, 
there was a crane game filled with 
plushies themed after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Look at this. Hehe, a round face, an 
adorable shape, and best of all—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah... If I could just feel them, perhaps 
I'd be able to play an even more dolce 
melody...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Sounds of Earth wants a Paka 
Petit plushie.
choice_data_list: Shall I try to get it?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Then I leave it to you! Play a melodious 
tune upon the instrument known as the 
crane.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"I'll liven things up with an obbligato 
too! Come—let the session begin!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
